sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We welcome your suggestion of a 24-month contract, as it reflects the long-term trust that has always characterized our cooperation between our family foundry and your respected company. In return for the extended contract duration, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €51.30 per unit.

For this adjusted Angebot, our terms are a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

It is always a privilege to build upon our shared history and shared values, and we look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your slightly improved offer, but it remains far below a level that sustains our high-quality production. To demonstrate our commitment to our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.10 per unit. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We kindly ask you to review your position and make a more substantial step towards a mutually viable agreement. It has always been a point of pride for our foundry to stand by our long relationship, and we trust we can find a path forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.90 per unit. Along with this unit price, our offer is based on a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality of work our craftsmen deliver, as well as the deep roots and long relationship we share with your valued business. However, to sustain this commitment over time, we must ask for a more substantial concession on your part to reach an agreement that honors our shared history. We remain confident that we can find a good path forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued movement, which reflects the value of our long-standing cooperation. In response to your latest proposal, we are prepared to make a further concession and lower our price to €50.40 per unit. As we are reaching the limits of what is viable for our family foundry, we ask for a more substantial step from your side to conclude this negotiation.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. For this Angebot, we propose a price of €50.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and it will be valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
